summary: Quoin Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing under Items 7.01 and 8.01 that the EMA granted Orphan Drug Designation in Europe to its lead candidate QRX003 for Peeling Skin Syndrome. The designation provides protocol scientific advice, fee reductions, EU grant access, and, if approved, ten years of EU market exclusivity. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, advisors, or board recommendation appear. Quoin intends to start the first formal Peeling Skin Syndrome clinical study before year end. This is a routine regulatory/clinical milestone disclosure, not a special situation; watch enrollment timing and any licensing or financing implications.
